appraisal_events.evidence: "l'interruption et le commentaire qui furent apportés une fois par une visite de Swann à la lecture que j'étais en train de faire du livre... de Bergotte, eut cette conséquence que, pour longtemps... ce ne fut plus sur un mur décoré de fleurs violettes... mais... devant le portail d'une cathédrale gothique, que se détacha désormais l'image d'une des femmes dont je rêvais."
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator credits Swann's conversation during a visit with a lasting, formative effect on his private imagination, implicitly crediting Swann with a striking conversational and aesthetic authority.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's remarks are portrayed as powerful enough to permanently reshape the narrator's imaginative world, marking him locally as a figure of conversational and aesthetic discernment.

ambiguities: The evaluative target of the described effect is genuinely uncertain: the passage may be read as elevating Swann's conversational authority, or as indirectly lending prestige to Bergotte (the author being read) through the association with Swann's commentary, rather than as a clean single-character appraisal.
